name: super-tmux
description: Tmux fundamentals and agent-CLI orchestration for Claude Code: daily tmux workflows, plus driving agent CLIs (codex, claude) as visible pane co-workers with reuse, keep-shell, and multi-agent collaboration

plugins.name: tmux-core
plugins.description: Daily tmux fundamentals and best practices: session/window/pane model, dev layouts, persistent sessions, attach/detach, copy-mode and scrollback, plus the send-keys/capture-pane primitives the tmux-agent plugin builds on. Agent-free and useful standalone.

plugins.name: tmux-agent
plugins.description: Drive agent CLIs (codex, claude, or any interactive CLI) as visible tmux pane co-workers: reuse-by-default routing, keep-shell panes, named parallel workers, idle/blocked detection, and per-agent calibration profiles with a generic fallback for unknown CLIs. Depends on the tmux-core plugin.
